effects.effect: Whenever you land after a fall, or if any falling creature lands within 2 squares of you, you can use a free [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) to reduce the falling damage by an amount equal to 2 + your [Reason](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/reason) score.
